title: Discord Launches Vice City-Themed Takeover Ahead of GTA VI
description: RockstarINTEL reports that Discord has partnered with Rockstar Games for a limited-time Vice City experience ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI. The takeover adds a Vice City color theme, custom app icon, and special Display Name Style to Discord, available on desktop and mobile through Quest Home and app
youtubeTitle: GTA VI Discord Vice City Theme and Rewards Explained
socialHook: Discord and Rockstar Games are bringing Vice City to Discord with a limited-time theme ahead of GTA VI.

sections.heading: Discord Vice City Takeover Details
paragraphs: According to RockstarINTEL, Discord has teamed up with Rockstar Games to bring a limited-time Vice City experience to its platform ahead of the Grand Theft Auto VI release. The takeover includes a new Vice City color theme, a custom app icon, and a special Display Name Style. RockstarINTEL reports this is the first time Discord has allowed a game's visual identity to be brought directly into the platform, and all three features are available on desktop and mobile.

sections.heading: Availability, Quests, and Rewards
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL states players can access the new theme through Discord's Quest Home until November 22, after which the color theme and app icon will be under Appearance settings on desktop and App Settings on mobile. The Display Name Style can be applied through the profile customization menu. The Vice City experience is available to everyone until December 13, while Discord Nitro members, excluding Nitro Basic subscribers, can keep using it until February 20. A Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Quest lets players earn Discord Orbs before it ends on November 18.

sections.heading: What Remains Unconfirmed
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL did not publish a separate confirmation from Rockstar Games regarding the specific partnership terms, and the report does not enumerate every exclusive Rockstar reward tied to the Discord Quests. The coverage attributes the launch details to Discord and does not establish additional unannounced GTA VI release information beyond the collaboration itself.
